description: This Java source file defines the `Contextual` class, which encapsulates a message with contextual information about the actor processing it in an Akka-based system. It manages message metadata, sender/receiver references, timers, logging, entity identification, and coordination for message handling and forwarding within the system.

classes.name: Contextual
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a message along with detailed context about the actor processing it, including metadata, entity information, timers, logging, and message forwarding capabilities.

methods.name: forActor
methods.description: Creates a new Contextual instance for an actor with specified actor references, timeout, logger, and response receivers, initializing the context without an initial message.

methods.name: withAskFuture
methods.description: Returns a new Contextual instance with the specified future task to be performed before forwarding the message.

methods.name: getMessageOptional
methods.description: Retrieves the message as an Optional, which may be empty if the message is null.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message, throwing an exception if it is null.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef representing the sender of the message.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the EntityId associated with the message, defaulting to a dummy ID if not available.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders from the message, or an empty headers object if message is null.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a message with the specified DittoHeaders set.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Creates a new Contextual wrapping the specified message, maintaining existing context data.

methods.name: tryToMapMessage
methods.description: Attempts to map the current message to another message type using the provided function.
